title: Choo-choo train, a full written specification
model: Purple Skippy: Claude Code on Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8), local and free
prompt: BUILD_REQUEST_V2: a 4-4-0 locomotive, tender and two passenger cars specified part by part (proportions in blocks, materials, how the parts join), v1's mistakes, and a loop of render, look (the vision model describes each pass), fix
verdict: Much better parts: a long boiler on its frame with gold domes, bell and red bands, a cab with windows, a cowcatcher, a big smoke plume, and real passenger cars (clerestory roofs, windows on both sides, stripes, end railings), a platform, depot and water tower. One big miss: both passenger cars and their railings float in the air beside the plate, off the track, and the wheels are thin rings. It looked at each pass through the vision model, which called the scene recognisable and missed the floating cars: describing a picture is not checking it. Next: an objective floating-parts check in the runtime, and pointed questions for the look.
